decision.explanation: Both the University of the Pacific (D1S11, D1S13) and Aarhus University (D2S2, D2S5, D2S7) are directly stated as institutions attended by George H. Hess in the original sources. These are distinct referents and complementary answers, supported by direct statements in the text. Neither is contradicted by the other, and both are relevant to the question about educational institutions he attended.
